reviews.title: платно
reviews.text: Разработчик на штопал много одинаковых приложений с абсолютно одинаковым интерфейсом и платный подпиской

reviews.title: Forcing purchase
reviews.text: With update of “read only” when trying to view past events- it’s blocked out with only option to purchase premium version- before this it was free as it should be. Another app becomes waste of space- delete.

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: I paid a lifetime charge of £22 as I believed the diary on my IPad would sync with my IPhone.   It it doesn’t and I cannot get any app support.

reviews.title: Change to premium with no warning.
reviews.text: Recently I noticed that I can’t go either back or forward in the planner without it trying to get me to pay for an upgrade. Very disappointing. I’ve used this for years but will be changing to another app now. The most annoying thing was that there was no warning, it just suddenly blocked me looking at anything more than a few days away. Not impressed. 😡

reviews.title: Update DELETED all notes!!!
reviews.text:
App Support doesn’t work! No Email response! This new subscription update deleted ALL of my notes, and I have backups on icloud. Someone needs to fix this or restore my data please.

I use this app everyday, now I don’t trust it. Please help!

reviews.title: Bad update
reviews.text: Well this app was my favorite of all. But the new update blurs out even the past week of entertainment and also cuts off days. Horrible update to force a purchase. Bad move because now I won’t use it and I’ll find a replacement of an app that isn’t so greedy they kill the app you have already allowed others to use. Don’t get the app. It is no good if you want to look at anything before the week your on.

reviews.title: The new upgrade has ruined it
reviews.text: I used to love this app but they’ve upgraded and now it’s awful.  There’s no way to contact them to ask for it to be put back to earlier mode.

reviews.title: Update
reviews.text: I have used and loved the Paper Planner for years now. They just updated, and I updated to the paid version, and not very happy.. It says you can make notifications, but there's no notification icon. And when you try to get help and push contact us, it goes straight to home page!

reviews.title: Chris absolutely useless.
reviews.text: I bought two Pro subscriptions for my iPad and iPhone, they won't sync say entries. I've emailed support 3 times, nothing back. Very poor

reviews.title: Sync?
reviews.text: Doesn’t sync with other Apple devices. Apple support tried to help but we both gave up.
